repair: Only fastp path arguments were changed to forward slashes so fastp 1.3.3 writes a valid JSON command field.
fastp_base_field_limitation: The raw report is retained unchanged. Total-base values show exact modulo-2^32 wrapping and mean-length/GC values conflict with read counts and cycle length; these fields are excluded from inference and are not used by fragment filtering, density shares, TPM-like values, or the release gate.
public_record_note: Process IDs, temporary logs, orchestration history, review timestamps, and release-control fields were omitted.
